# Garage Customs FL (concept by Kerblabs)

> Owner-installed paint protection film, vinyl wrap, ceramic coating, window tint and wheel powder coating in Doral, FL, serving Miami and South Florida.

## Facts (from garagecustomsfl.com)
- Address: 3004 NW 79th Ave, Doral, FL 33122
- Phone: (786) 795-0237
- Email: garagecustomsfl@gmail.com
- Instagram: @garagecustomsfl
- Hours: Mon-Sat 10 am-7 pm; Sundays and after hours by appointment only. No walk-ins.
- XPEL and STEK certified installer; owner-installed work; 10-year PPF manufacturer warranty
- 5.0 stars on Google, 218 reviews (as stated on their site)

## Services
- Paint Protection Film: XPEL (including Ultimate Plus), STEK DYNOshield, Stealth
- Vinyl Car Wrapping: 3M, Avery Dennison, Inozetek
- Ceramic Coating: Ceramic Pro
- Window Tinting: XPEL
- Powder Coating for Wheels

## Actions
- Book: call (786) 795-0237, email garagecustomsfl@gmail.com, or message @garagecustomsfl on Instagram

## FAQ
- Can I walk in? No, appointments only; see hours above.
- Prices: the studio's site says PPF full front packages start at $1,499; other prices not published, ask the studio.
